recommendation:
I had the pleasure of being Chamith’s superior, and I can confidently say he is one of the most talented engineers I’ve worked with.

Chamith has exceptional expertise across both frontend and backend development. He is truly a master of UI/frontend engineering, with a strong eye for detail, user experience, and modern design practices. At the same time, his backend knowledge allows him to build complete, scalable, and reliable solutions end-to-end.

What stands out most is his ability to turn complex requirements into clean, efficient, and user-friendly products. He consistently delivers high-quality work, takes ownership of challenges, and collaborates effectively with the team.

Any organization would be fortunate to have Chamith on their team, and I highly recommend him for any full-stack or frontend-focused engineering role.
